subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: Should accepted gateway-run disconnects land with this narrow fresh-session recook fallback now, or should the PR wait for a reattach-first/no-recook recovery design?
rationale: The patch fixes same-session duplicate transcript state, but it deliberately keeps the existing two-execution fallback boundary for accepted disconnects, which is a product and operator-impact choice rather than a mechanical correctness question.

options.title: Land the narrow fresh-session fix
options.body: Accept the existing timeout-style recook fallback for this rare path, merge after exact-head validation, and leave reattach-first recovery to the linked product issue.

options.title: Require reattach-first before merge
options.body: Ask the contributor to extend this PR into the broader recovery design so accepted disconnects try `agent.wait` before any embedded rerun.

options.title: Pause if duplicate side effects are unacceptable
options.body: Do not land this branch unless maintainers decide that a possible second model/tool/delivery execution is an acceptable failure mode.

recommendation.body: Accept the existing timeout-style recook fallback for this rare path, merge after exact-head validation, and leave reattach-first recovery to the linked product issue.
